notes.title: Greyvale Rivalry - Status Update #10
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/ec74f218f5c3b14f50d6217b2360c4cb62181d9b.png"]

Hello everyone,
[p align="start"]We're back with the sixth Greyvale Rivalry status update. The last two weeks were pretty chill, except for the couple of days we spent working on the wallpaper DLC of The Grey Dream. We spent a couple of days on that, but the rest of the time was really productive. With these two weeks, we've reached a total of 3,000 renders. We finished a scene and started working on a new one. You might be wondering why we jumped from the 12th to the 14th scene in the rendering process. We wanted to tackle the smaller scenes before getting into a big one again.
[p align="start"]8.5th Scene: We realised that we're terrible at providing estimates for scenes. We estimated that it would take around 160 renders. However, this scene ended up requiring 240 renders, plus one animation, and a couple more are on the way. After finishing the scene, we noticed a problem with a certain part, which meant we had to adjust the lighting one by one, costing us a day.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/00a74ab11c7d72f792264363d455ac262c961be5.png"]14th Scene: We started working on this one on Friday. So far, it's been great. We were going to start working on it a day or two earlier, but we felt that something was missing from the scene, so we rewrote some parts of it. We've done 120 renders so far.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/ef13102465691de3d7870e1bb23dcacae6135b54.png"]We've also changed 2 characters:
[p align="start"]Valeria

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/7d220528e9438e50848242d93abecc7297eef6b7.png"]Vivian

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/55844595fd8510b4783bb7bbc3dac38401d4c2f9.png"]

Before we wrap up the status, Kagan wanted to talk about the change he made with the renders:
[p align="start"]We used to use denoise in our renders, but recently we've noticed that it causes color banding, loss of detail, and makes the images look pastel-like. We actually knew about this from the very beginning, but when we were working on The Grey Dream, we started doing it this way because our systems were terrible, so we just continued with it. We also started doing Greyvale in the same way, just like we always had, but after the last episode of Grey Dream, we thought it would be nice to mix things up a bit. You might have noticed that in Grey Dream, if there was a solid-colored wall in the background, strange color transitions could occur, which could be distracting. We've left a little example for you below. Just a heads-up that denoise will still be hanging around in the Greyvale renders for a little while. We've done about 2,800 images like this, and we can't really go back and fix them right now. However, color banding won't be an issue from scenes 8.5 and 14 onwards! This doesn't mean there'll be a huge difference in the renders, but you'll be able to see more detail in some areas and won't encounter the colour banding issue.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/cc5d4b33bd3d6e0051decc2be3fa70991c833604.png"]

One last thing: We've almost reached 5,000 on the Steam wishlist for Greyvale Rivalry, and we thank you for that!

The Greys

notes.title: Greyvale Rivalry - Status Update #8
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/60c88c0e17a423f37df9efcb82cae084c68d3968.png

Hello everyone,

After a long break, we're back with another Greyvale Rivalry status update. If you regularly read our status updates, you may know that we took a break from Greyvale to speed up the animation rendering process for The Grey Dream. Since then, we have achieved a lot, and we have also grown tired of working on the same scenes for a couple of weeks. So, last week, we resumed the development cycle of Greyvale to have some fun. During this time, we also realised that working on two games prevented us from burning out, as the change of pace gave us a fresh start. It may sound strange, but we wanted to share how it made us feel.

So, what's new?

9th Scene: We were wondering whether to put this one as a separate scene since it's very intertwined with the 10th scene, but since it has a change of scenery, we've decided to separate it. Total render count: 38
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/cab0760452fc3b178973ab1fd34f6ccc0d6c4121.png

10th Scene: It's finished! While working on it, we noticed a terrible mistake that we had made with one of the scenes, which would affect this one. We're glad we caught it early, as it didn't cause us to fall behind. Total render count: 78
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/69acf494cd2cc34a7c366f89873870d8f194f3ac.png

11th Scene: This is our latest scene at the moment. We're still working on it, which will probably keep us occupied for the next few days. As well as the static renders, we thought a short cinematic might suit the scene. It hasn't been confirmed yet, but it looks very likely. It's still a WIP scene, but to give a render count, it would be around 130-150
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/528c9e44e85632e7a23848b843d25b25671a7ee3.png

Last thing, we thought adding some effects to football scenes could be cool. Let us know what you think about them.

Before:

After:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/6f6e436ed7035a91c9aedade3a9f91a044999f13.png

notes.title: Greyvale Rivalry - Status Update #7
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/217f05bc48810d0738dadebae31eaa6189dbcfce.png

Hello everyone,

We're back with another update. This week we don't have multiple scenes to talk about as we were busy with scene 8. Before we get to the scene talk, let's take a look at what we've been up to over the past week. We've been looking for music and SFX, as well as working on the menu design. We have a general idea of what we want the menu to look like and we're making progress. Some people have messaged us asking how much of the game is complete. As of today, we've reached 2000 renders and the first chapter is about 60% complete, not counting the animations. Before we get to the scene of the week, we would like to thank you all for wishlisting the game on Steam. As of this week, we've reached 2k wishlists, so we'd like to thank you all for that. 

Let's move on to the scene of the week.

Scene eight: We're still working on it. In the last update, we mentioned that it might end up being a 200+ render scene. Well... It's currently around 300 and we're still working on it. While working on the scene we decided to change one of the character's clothes, which set us back a day, but in the end, we thought the new outfit suited the scene better. We also need to do some animation for it, but our plan is to skip the animation for now and get on with the rest of the scenes, then come back and do the animation when it's all done.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/f9fa41e1e282f39828cd08c7161aff708cfe263d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/634634928a30844f1d7fcc8761f41b16e144675a.png

The Greys

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/51dd5fbc6a337420060a4a33dbd1396a66727cf7.png
Hello everyone,

We wanted to post this update yesterday but we were out of town for the day so sorry for the delay. We also took a few days off last week. After the break we started working on the eighth scene this week. From the looks of it, we're 90% sure that this will end up being one of our favourite scenes. It's also on the longer side in terms of dialogue. If everything goes as planned, we should be able to finish this scene this week and then either go back to working on scene 2 or start working on scene 9.

Let's move on to the scenes:

Second scene: No new static renders in this scene, but we did render 3 more animations for this scene while we took a few days off.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/613b060e6411a92bab87d87f97411ba28adf9fb9.png

Seventh scene: It ended up being 90 renders. We still need to render one or two animations for this one, but at least it doesn't require any active work.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/385c823190e7d3c667d310b8121ab454ebdf6cb7.png

Eighth scene: 82 renders so far. By our estimation it will easily end up being a 200+ render scene.

notes.title: Greyvale Rivalry - Status Update #4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/9ca8fad840bd6d4a812b3cda0adf0ff77dfbf6ff.png
Hello everyone,

We're back with another status update. Let's start with the total number of renders. As of today we've reached 1500 static renders. We would like to have less of them, but the scenes were too dynamic and we didn't want to cut them short, so the first six scenes ended up with this many renders. Besides the renders, we've also rendered the first animation of the game. It's about 360 and it crashed a couple of times but we got it to work. Everything is going great so far. We even thought about giving the game a release date, but it's better to hold off on that idea for a while.

Let's talk about the scenes.

Fifth scene: It's finally done. This scene alone took almost a week to complete because it takes place in several different environments. In the end, there were 320 renders and 1 animation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/700ef01c4c9c7a2acb09820b50c18dd46a9c71a4.png
Sixth scene: This scene wasn't that long in terms of renders, but it felt good to do a shorter scene after all the long ones. We finalized the scene with 130 renders.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/58841d492a19c1c5cf43853fbabfffd5b1c1b77c.png
The Greys

notes.title: Greyvale Rivalry - Status Update #3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are back with the third status update. The last two weeks have been pretty cool. Strangely enough, we had no problems or anyone got sick or anything. Let's just get to the scenes since we have nothing else to talk about this week.

Fourth scene: It's finally done. It ended up being 218 renders. We're thinking about changing some dialogue here and there, but overall we're done with this one.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/49a1edca92c92ff78aaf62c3d8d17ad6dfcb4c60.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/57c38aa988f55b29f37539842ff6686a41021a30.png

The Greys

notes.title: Greyvale Rivalry - Status Update #2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/77d815fdaeb54380b55158a4d4ff350057c204f1.png
Hello everyone,

It's been over a month since the first status update, so it was about time for a second one.

We've been busy with the release of our other game and the development of its next chapter, so we couldn't really focus on the Greyvale Rivalry until the beginning of February. But now that we've started, we thought it was time to let you know what's going on.

Before we get to the scene-by-scene progress updates, we wanted to let you know that we've decided to stop stating the percentage of scenes completed, as it's unrealistic for the scenes. For example, we mentioned that 130 renders would be about 70% of the scene, but it ended up being 50%. Now that we've cleared that up, let's talk about the scenes.

Second scene: We mentioned that the second scene was the biggest part of the first episode, but we're still working on it. We've done another 50 renders for it and it's still in development.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/e5fd0dfbba610338469a5f15c5b900a3756bb61f.png
Third scene: We're finally done with this scene. It ended up being 270 renders along with a bunch of transition renders, but we're pretty happy with the results.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/ea4428c6b853407078d00e9f12d45493a0bab8ca.png
Fourth scene: This one is also completely written, but while we were making it we decided to change a few things, so we'll have to make some adjustments to the dialog. Other than that, it's going great. We've reached 130 renders on it and it's still going strong.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438919/9f03829d83a4fc870cb2ddbb4595bbef1d42fd7f.png
The Greys
